title: Happy raccoon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='22' r='11' fill='#6b5a8e'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='22' r='11' fill='#6b5a8e'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='22' r='6' fill='#c9a7d8'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='22' r='6' fill='#c9a7d8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='30' ry='26' fill='#8a7bb0'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='23' ry='18' fill='#b8a9d6'/>

  <ellipse cx='35' cy='44' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#4a3a6e'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='44' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#4a3a6e'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='12' ry='8' fill='#e2d6f5' opacity='0.45'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='24' ry='16' fill='#8a7bb0'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='91' rx='15' ry='11' fill='#dcCFf0'/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='90' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#6b5a8e'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='90' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#6b5a8e'/>
